competencies.name: Python engineering
competencies.limit: Runnable loaders and fixture tests; synthetic workload.

competencies.name: SQL and dimensional/SCD modelling
competencies.limit: Event-time history and reconciled roll-ups; no claim of every platform dialect.

competencies.name: Data quality, tests and lineage
competencies.limit: Injected defects, contracts and source-to-report lineage.

competencies.name: Incremental loads and reliability
competencies.limit: Watermarks, transactions and crash recovery; source-CDC platform operation is not demonstrated.

competencies.name: Orchestration and CI/CD
competencies.limit: Python DAG and Actions, with retries and run logs; Airflow is a separate gap.

competencies.name: AI-assisted analytics
competencies.limit: Grounded LLM notes: a validator rejects any uncited number, a template takes over, a grader tests each rule with a passing and a failing note, and ten recorded cases run offline in CI. ADR 0006 is an outcome evaluation of the report's rule flags against seeded ground truth, not of the LLM. Not counted until merged: the failed-run doctor (PR #360). No trained ML product or evaluation with real users; synthetic data only.

competencies.name: Stakeholder communication
competencies.limit: A case study and ADRs that state each decision with its cost, a role section on how the work was split and reviewed, owner-decision ADRs 0007–0009 that give a recommendation, what was declined and who decided, and a weekly note written from cited figures and labelled as AI-generated or as a template fallback. The readers are reviewers of a synthetic project: no external stakeholder sign-off, adoption or feedback evidence.

competencies.name: Cloud platform and IaC
competencies.limit: Deliberately excluded ([decision](scope/319-cloud-iac.md)): state in Cloudflare R2 and deploys to Pages from Actions are implemented; AWS/Azure/GCP operations and IaC would need cloud accounts (often paid beyond free tiers) and are not demonstrated. A separate lab would be the honest test.

competencies.name: Managed cloud warehouses
competencies.limit: Deliberately excluded ([decision](scope/320-managed-warehouses.md)): DuckDB runs the pipeline and the browser by design; the Snowflake-labelled source is local Parquet. Snowflake/BigQuery/Redshift would need a cloud account (often paid beyond free tiers) and are not demonstrated. A separate lab would be the honest test.

competencies.name: Spark and managed lakehouse
competencies.limit: One KPI rebuilt in local-mode PySpark on fixtures, with dbt parity and one-row failure tests; no cluster, Databricks, tuning at scale, Delta or medallion layout.

competencies.name: Semantic layer and BI access
competencies.limit: Local MetricFlow lab: five §7 KPIs as dbt metrics match mart_org_weekly at every org level on fixtures (the lead rate also on a backdated copy with full 12-month windows), with wrong-definition tests and an illustrative row-level filter. No Power BI model, DAX, Tableau or deployed BI permissions.

competencies.name: Airflow operations
competencies.limit: Local Airflow 3.3.2 lab: the runner's stages as a weekly DAG with retries, timeouts and tested failure and re-run paths, run with dags test on SQLite. No deployed scheduler, executor or SLA/alert history.

competencies.name: Legacy migration
competencies.limit: Local synthetic parity lab: an old-style SQL report reconciled with the dbt mart, with documented quirk mappings; no real SAS, production cutover or dual-run period.

competencies.name: Streaming and open table formats
competencies.limit: Local Iceberg lab on 55 fixture rows: idempotent weekly partition overwrite, schema evolution, time travel and DuckDB read-back, with a SQLite catalog, one writer and no object store. Streaming (Kafka/Flink) is deliberately excluded from this weekly batch design.

competencies.name: Scala/Java/Go systems work
competencies.limit: No direct implementation in these languages.

competencies.name: Security and regulated governance
competencies.limit: A site-wide Content-Security-Policy checked in CI against DuckDB-WASM, secrets read only from environment variables, a synthetic-only data rule, and a conditional-write lock on shared state. Cloudflare Access gated the site until the owner made it public on purpose (#255); no Access policy lives in this repository. Operational alerting: a rejected model credential opens a named alert instead of failing silently, and the alert closes when a run recovers. No regulated IAM, PII controls, row-level security or audit sign-off.

competencies.name: Performance and cost at scale
competencies.limit: Measured batch benchmark at about 2.2M activities; no TB/distributed or provider-cost proof.
